faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and unit price for Custom Acrylic-Insert & LED Light-Up Medals?
faqs.answer: The starting wholesale MOQ for Custom Acrylic-Insert & LED Light-Up Medals is 300 pcs. Reference factory-direct tiered pricing is $3.85/pc (300 pcs starter tier), $2.65/pc (500 pcs tier), and $1.98/pc (2,000+ pcs volume tier), depending on size and finish complexity.

faqs.question: What is the mold or tooling fee for Custom Acrylic-Insert & LED Light-Up Medals, and when is it waived?
faqs.answer: Tooling policy for Custom Acrylic-Insert & LED Light-Up Medals is $145 Bezel Mold (Waived @ 1,000+). Every client receives custom steel tooling cut strictly to their artwork, stored free of charge for 3 years in our Zhongshan mold vault so subsequent reorders pay $0 mold fees.

faqs.question: What base materials and manufacturing crafts are used on Custom Acrylic-Insert & LED Light-Up Medals?
faqs.answer: Custom Acrylic-Insert & LED Light-Up Medals is custom-engineered from Zinc Alloy + Acrylic + LED using Hollow Zinc Bezel + Etched Acrylic + Multi-Mode LED, sized around Ø82×6.5mm at approximately 110g per unit (custom dimensions available).

faqs.question: Which electroplating colors and surface finishes are available for Custom Acrylic-Insert & LED Light-Up Medals?
faqs.answer: Standard factory surface options for this custom craft include Matte Black / Chrome / Satin Gold. Dual-tone masking plating and custom matte or clear protective lacquer coatings are also available upon request.

faqs.question: What backings, attachments, and accessories come with Custom Acrylic-Insert & LED Light-Up Medals?

faqs.question: Can we get a free digital artwork proof before paying for tooling or samples?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send your vector logo (.AI, .EPS, .SVG, or vector .PDF) or rough sketch via our quote form or WhatsApp, and our engineering team will send a free 1:1 scaled digital production proof within 12 hours.

faqs.answer: Yes. Pre-production physical samples take 7–10 business days (paid sample covers custom mold cutting to your design, plating, and enamel finishing; courier air freight is billed at carrier cost or via your DHL/FedEx account).

faqs.question: What is the bulk production lead time for Custom Acrylic-Insert & LED Light-Up Medals?

faqs.question: Does Custom Acrylic-Insert & LED Light-Up Medals meet US CPSIA, California Prop 65, and EU REACH safety standards?
faqs.answer: Yes. All raw metals, electroplating baths, and Pantone enamel pigments comply with US CPSIA (<90 ppm lead), California Prop 65, and EU REACH / EN 1811 nickel-release regulations.

faqs.question: What retail packaging upgrades are compatible with Custom Acrylic-Insert & LED Light-Up Medals?
